report:
Fresh complete followup assessment of staleness. Saved/read the previous report and all captures before start, recaptured all four dependencies, and compared every fragment. The sole delta is an association comment for placeholder_status before test inventory construction in review.rs. The claim, all six associated tests, fixture helpers, review policy, check.rs and lib.rs are unchanged. There is no behavioral change to freshness or acceptance.

The full claim requires matching anchor/schema/policy, complete claim and implementation/test inputs, current selected source and association metadata, identity-based movement tolerance, exact whole-file text including whitespace, and complete output without requested edits. The sole ordinary implementation acceptable checks checklist versions, locates the matching anchor, requires inputs_match, requires output with nonblank reviewer/report and valid edit strings, and requires no edits. read_summary independently rejects directory/anchor mismatch and unsupported schema/policy; loading exposes invalid/unfinished records. input_errors compares verification prompt, implementation/test metadata and all initial fragments, then resolves every additional selector and checks exact content. Claim/test selectors use semantic identities rather than line offsets; whole-file source representation preserves blank lines and final newlines. record refuses invalid output or stale context before completion. Captured check orchestration uses inventory/load_saved/validate/acceptable rather than bypassing these checks. The new comment does not alter any path.

All six ordinary tests were read fully. unsupported_versions_and_mismatched_identity_cannot_pass separately mutates anchor, schema and policy and requires the gate to report the anchor and corresponding reason. added_or_removed_associations_invalidate_unchanged_saved_fragments requires failures after adding/removing tests and adding implementation evidence while explicitly preserving the earlier test metadata identity. test_selector_preserves_metadata_and_ignores_unrelated_line_movement asserts crate/target/path/file/cfg/status, exact captured function, continued validity after unrelated preceding text, and invalidity after cfg changes. complete_claim_blocks_are_selected_but_unrelated_movement_is_not_stale asserts full multiline paragraph/list/table/code text, survival of preceding blank-line and outside-prose edits, and invalidation for each changed substantive block. whole_files_and_ranges_preserve_exact_line_endings_and_detect_selected_edits verifies CRLF, blank lines, unterminated last line, invalid ranges, selected versus unselected range changes, repeated exact whole-file reads, and invalidation after merely adding a final newline. invalid_reports_and_stale_inputs_never_complete_an_active_review rejects recording without a start and blank output fields/edits, verifies output absence, rejects changed implementation text without rewriting input, and shows concrete requested edits keep the gate failing; it also verifies the exact three-field output shape.

The captured temporary-workspace fixture invokes real review/check APIs and leaves substantive assertions in test bodies. No TODO/N/A entries or deferrals exist. Plausible failures to compare versions, cfg, late claim blocks, blank-line text, or requested edits are directly targeted by these assertions. The actual single marker-only change was assessed against every requirement and the prior complete assessment; all other relied-on inputs were verified unchanged. No source edits or test reruns occurred; this review performed start/read/record and source inspection, with central execution reported separately. No requested edits.
